label: Copy-phase input b (late in long sequences)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost only when the fed-back input token is b (98.7% of activation mass; small residue on i/j/h). It never fires in the original phase or on the delimiter. Within copy-phase b inputs it is selective: it is nearly silent at recall_idx <= 2 and in short sequences (L <= 5), and grows with L (L=9 holds 51% of mass). The largest activations come when the b is about the 3rd-4th original token and the next output is i (also h, j, b, u, v); e.g. 0 y j b i ... gives the max. Even with these conditions only about 37% of predicted steps are active, so precision is incomplete: many copy-phase b steps in long sequences stay silent, and the predicate does not capture what decides which ones fire. Simplest form (copy phase & in_tok==b) has recall 0.97 but precision 0.18.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: b, i, j, h, u, m; least: t, a, z, e) and the token being output (most: i, h, b, j, v, u; least: z, w, q, -); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, t=12.
